 WHERE note_id = :test_band_header.note_id;

 :system.message_level := 0;

end;

PROCEDURE CREATE_GROUP_BAND_RESULTS IS
 band_count number(2);
 tot_rows number(3);
 rg_id recordgroup;
 cl_id groupcolumn;
 cl_id2 groupcolumn;
 ele_num number(3); 
 cur_item varchar2(40);
 itemno varchar2(30);
 ctr number(4) := 0;
 ctr2 number(4) := 0; 
 cursor c0 is 
 select band_name, band_seq from valid_test_bands
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id
 and test_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_type 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate)
 order by band_seq;
 cursor c1 is 
 select set_number, test_intp 
 from valid_test_band_matrix_header
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id 
 and test_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_type 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
BEGIN
 -----Upload all existing combinations 1.Create Group ----------
 SELECT count(*) INTO band_count
 FROM valid_test_bands 
 WHERE test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id 
 AND test_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_type 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate);

 SELECT count(*) INTO tot_rows
 FROM valid_test_band_matrix_header
 WHERE test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id
 AND test_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_type 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate);

 rg_id := find_group('RESULTS');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(rg_id);
 END IF;
 rg_id := create_group('RESULTS');
 cl_id := add_group_column('RESULTS','SET_NO',NUMBER_COLUMN); 
 cl_id := add_group_column('RESULTS','INTP',CHAR_COLUMN,5);

 for i in 1 .. band_count
 loop 
 itemno := lpad(to_char(i),2,'0');
 cl_id := add_group_column('RESULTS','RES'||itemno,CHAR_COLUMN,4); 
 cl_id := add_group_column('RESULTS','RSEQ'||itemno,NUMBER_COLUMN);
 cl_id := add_group_column('RESULTS','BAND'||itemno,CHAR_COLUMN,6);
 end loop;
 -------------Group Created Now upload results------------------------ 
 ctr := 0;
 for head in c1 
 loop 
 ctr := ctr + 1;
 DECLARE
 temp_var varchar2(1);
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_var
 FROM valid_test_bands vtb, valid_test_band_matrix_detail vtbmd
 WHERE vtb.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id
 AND vtb.test_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_type 
 AND vtb.test_id = vtbmd.test_id
 AND vtb.band_name = vtbmd.band_name
 AND vtbmd.set_number = head.set_number
 AND vtb.band_seq = 999;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 ADD_GROUP_ROW('RESULTS',END_OF_GROUP);
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('RESULTS.SET_NO',ctr,head.set_number);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('RESULTS.INTP',ctr,head.test_intp);
 ctr2 := 0;
 for h in c0
 loop
 ctr2 := ctr2 + 1;
 itemno := lpad(to_char(ctr2),2,'0');
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('RESULTS.RSEQ' || itemno, ctr, h.band_seq);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('RESULTS.BAND' || itemno, ctr, h.band_name);
 DECLARE
 temp_var varchar2(5) := null;
 BEGIN
 SELECT band_value INTO temp_var
 FROM valid_test_band_matrix_detail
 WHERE set_number = head.set_number
 AND band_name = h.band_name;
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('RESULTS.RES' || itemno, ctr, temp_var);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error; 
 END;
 end loop; 
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 END;
 end loop; 
 :band_count := band_count;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

PROCEDURE validate_combination IS

 cl_id groupcolumn;

 row_num number(4);
 itemname1 varchar2(30);
 item1_val varchar2(3);
 itemname2 varchar2(30);

 temp_res varchar2(5);
 dummy varchar2(1);
 temp_seq number(2);
 arr_seq number(2);
 ctr number(2);
 bandname1 varchar2(30);
 bandname2 varchar2(30);
 cur_item varchar2(40) := :system.cursor_item;
 PNI_VAL varchar2(1);
 matched varchar2(1); 
BEGIN
 --CREATE RG for the entered results.
 rg_id := FIND_GROUP('SUPER');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN

 END IF;

 go_block('test_band_detail');

 for i in 1 .. :band_count
 loop

 cl_id := add_group_column('SUPER','BAND_VAL'||itemno,CHAR_COLUMN,3);

 loop

 set_group_char_cell('SUPER.BAND_VAL'||itemno,1, :test_band_detail.super_band_val); 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 ctr := ctr + 1;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 ----------- VALIDATE COMBINATION --------------------------------
 res_rows := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('RESULTS');
--message(to_char(res_rows));
 for i in 1 .. res_rows
 loop
 markset := 'Y'; 
 for j in 1 .. :band_count
 loop 
 bandname1 := 'SUPER.BAND' || lpad(to_char(j),2,'0'); -- Take first super band
 for k in 1 .. :band_count -- Find Matching Band Name
 loop
 matched := 'N';
 bandname2 := 'RESULTS.BAND' || lpad(to_char(k),2,'0'); 
 IF get_group_char_cell(bandname1, 1) = -- IF band name matches
 get_group_char_cell(bandname2, i) -- Compare values
 THEN 
 matched := 'Y';
 itemname1 := 'SUPER.BAND_VAL' || lpad(to_char(j),2,'0');
 itemname2 := 'RESULTS.RES' || lpad(to_char(k),2,'0');
 item1_val := get_group_char_cell(itemname1,1); 
 IF item1_val is not null THEN 
 BEGIN
 SELECT result_seq 
 INTO temp_seq 
 FROM valid_band_results
 WHERE test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id
 AND result = item1_val;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END; 
 ELSE
 temp_seq := null;
 END IF;
 c_val := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(itemname2,i); 
 IF nvl(c_val,'XNULLX') != '?' THEN
 IF item1_val is null and c_val is null THEN
 null;
 ELSE
 IF item1_val IS NULL or c_val is null THEN
 markset := 'N';
 exit;
 END IF;
 IF temp_seq = 0 THEN
 PNI_val := 'N';
 ELSIF temp_seq != 0 and temp_seq < :ctrl_blk_1.ctrl_val_seq THEN
 PNI_val := 'I';
 ELSE 
 PNI_val := 'P';
 END IF; 
 IF PNI_val != c_val THEN 
 IF PNI_val = 'N' or c_val = 'N' THEN
 markset := 'N';
 exit;
 ELSIF PNI_val = 'P' and c_val = 'I' THEN
 null;
 ELSIF PNI_val = 'I' and c_val = 'P' THEN
 markset := 'N';
 exit;
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF matched = 'Y' THEN
 exit;
 END IF;
 end loop; --k
 IF markset = 'N' THEN
 exit;
 END IF;
 end loop; --j
--message('markset '|| to_char(i) || ' ' || markset);
 IF markset = 'Y' THEN 
 set_group_selection('RESULTS',i);
 END IF;
 end loop; --i
 IF GET_GROUP_SELECTION_COUNT('RESULTS') = '0' THEN
 show_error('1143');
 ELSE
 dummy := null;
 for i in 1 .. GET_GROUP_SELECTION_COUNT('RESULTS')
 loop 
 row_num := GET_GROUP_SELECTION('RESULTS',i);
 temp_res := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('RESULTS.INTP',row_num);
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'R' INTO dummy
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'BREAC'
 AND code = temp_res

 exit;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 null;
 END; 
 end loop;
 IF nvl(dummy,'X') != 'R' and get_block_property('other_test_band', status) != 'NEW'
 THEN 
 :sys_result := 'IND';
 ELSE

 :super_intp := :sys_result;
 BEGIN
 SELECT code_desc

PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting

BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Cursor_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

declare
 cur_rec number(3);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 IF get_block_property('TEST_BAND_DETAIL',status) = 'QUERY'
 and :test_band_header.super_intp = :ctrl_blk_1.old_super_intp 
 THEN
 show_error('8013');
 END IF; 
 IF :system.cursor_block = 'TEST_BAND_DETAIL' THEN
 VALIDATE_COMBINATION;
 go_block('test_band_header');
 END IF; 
 IF :test_band_header.void_code is null THEN
 go_item('test_band_header.void_code');
 show_error('0080'); 
 END IF;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 post;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 perform_commit;
end;
